title: Proportions: the farmhouse door, taller, opening
about: Day 3, 09:00, the farmer on the path just below the farmhouse door (14,7), facing it. Every tall door's frame rose 4 px in the proportions round (28 px frame on a 2 px step, a 26 px opening); walking up plays the door's open frames (DoorFx, obj_door_open_0..3), which must line up with the baked door.
